notes.13: Most candidates identified the correct product at the anode. Some candidates confused the electrolysis of aqueous and of molten salts and incorrectly chose option B .
notes.17: Option B was a popular incorrect choice. Candidates found the identification of a redox reaction challenging. Some candidates were also likely to give option C .
notes.18: Option A was a popular incorrect choice. Some candidates recalled glucose being involved in a photochemical reaction but did not read the statement clearly to interpret which reaction involving glucose was being described.
notes.19: Option A was a popular incorrect choice. This was found to be a very challenging question for all candidates. Most were able to recognise the effect of concentration on rate but did not consider the final volume of gas and therefore the moles of reactant used.
notes.25: The general properties of Group VII elements were not well known by some candidates who were almost as likely to give option B or option D .
notes.26: Option B was a popular incorrect choice. Most candidates were able to predict the trend in reactivity down Group II but not the density.
notes.28: Option D was a popular incorrect choice. The most common error was to reverse the order of reactivity of metal X and Y by misinterpreting the data given.
notes.32: Option B was a popular incorrect choice. Most candidates recalled the link between gas pressure and rate of reaction. Some candidates confused the effect of pressure on the position of equilibrium.
notes.36: Option C was a popular incorrect choice. Candidates found this a challenging question. The product of the reaction of bromine with an alkene was not well known.
notes.38: Some candidates were as likely to choose any of the options suggesting a degree of guessing.
notes.general_comments: Questions 2 , 8 , 29 and 30 had the lowest demand. Questions 17 , 19 and 43 were found to be more challenging.
